lines: reasons the holidays wreck your diet
cover.sub: Number 5 is sitting on every holiday plate.

reasons.head: Your workouts vanish from the calendar
reasons.sub: Travel, parties and short days push training aside, and one skipped week easily turns into four.

reasons.head: Your stress is through the roof
reasons.sub: Stress pulls you toward comfort food, the rich and sugary kind, not the veggies.

reasons.head: You've already written off December
reasons.sub: Promising to start fresh in January turns a few treats into six weeks off.

reasons.head: You think the extra pound will come off
reasons.sub: The average holiday gain is about a pound, and an NIH study found it usually stays on all year.

reasons.head: You have no idea what's on your plate
reasons.sub: Butter, cream and sugar hide in every holiday dish, so even a small plate is a total guess.
